letterAndDigit.title: Needs a letter and a digit

breachedCheck.title: Refuse breached passwords
breachedCheck.description: Checks the password against the Have I Been Pwned list (only the first 5 characters of its SHA-1 hash leave our server).

resetLimit.title: Reset e-mails per address per 15 minutes
resetLimit.description: More Forgot password requests for the same address answer rate_limited, whether or not it has an account.

resetHosts.title: More hosts for reset links
resetHosts.description: Forgot password links open a page of your website's domain (returnTo); list your other hosts here, for example your admin's (admin.shop.com). Over https only.

lockMode.title: Lock
lockMode.description: fixed: the lock below after the wrong passwords above; growing: after them, each further wrong password locks for twice as long, from 1 up to 60 minutes. Also used by Phone + password.

networkLimit.title: Tries per network and address per 15 minutes
networkLimit.description: 0: off. Also used by Phone + password.

personalCheck.title: Refuse personal passwords
personalCheck.description: Refuses new passwords holding the name, the e-mail address before the @, or a run of 4 keyboard or number steps (1234, qwer). Also used by Phone + password.
